literal: As heated it shines gold like, will emit light pain as it burns, as it burns, to those who can endure.
translation: Just as gold shines brighter the more it is heated in the fire, those who endure penance will shine brighter the more they are burned by pain.
modern: நெருப்பில் சுடச்சுடப் பொன் மேலும் ஒளிர்வது போல, தவம் செய்பவர்களைத் துன்பம் வருத்த வருத்த அவர்கள் மேலும் தூய்மையாகி ஒளி வீசுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet compares the process of penance to the refining of gold. Just as gold becomes purer and shines brighter the more it is heated in the fire, the character of those who undertake penance becomes more radiant the more they endure pain. The repetition of 'சுட' (to burn/heat) emphasizes the continuous and intense nature of both the refining fire and the hardships of penance. Through this endurance, their true inner light is revealed.
